text: At e <= 0.7 the accel_step control R2 lands in between (0.54-0.56), yet the final margin (0.24-0.26) and the formation step (60-70) both match the e <= 0.85 regime rather than falling between e <= 0.5 and e <= 0.85. Do margin and formation timing jump to their high-e values somewhere between e ceilings of 0.5 and 0.7, even while control R2 declines gradually? A matched sweep at e ceilings of 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.65 and 0.7 (same m2 range [0.1, 1], seeds 70-72, 5-step checkpoints) would show this.
